alerts.headline: Flood Watch issued October 21 at 10:28PM MDT until October 23 at 12:00PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Portions of southwest Colorado, including the following
areas, Animas River Basin, Four Corners/Upper Dolores River, San
Juan River Basin and Southwest San Juan Mountains and Utah,
including the following areas, Arches/Grand Flat,
Canyonlands/Natural Bridges, La Sal and Abajo Mountains and
Southeast Utah.

* WHEN...Through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, recent burn scars and other low-lying and
flood-prone locations. Low-water crossings may be flooded. Storm
drains and ditches may become clogged with debris.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Strong thunderstorms capable of producing heavy rain will be
possible across southern portions of Utah and Colorado through
Thursday evening. In addition widespread moderate to heavy
rainfall from a surge of tropical moisture will remain a threat
through early Friday morning.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
alerts.areaDesc: Southwest San Juan Mountains; Four Corners/Upper Dolores River; Animas River Basin; San Juan River Basin; Southeast Utah; Arches/Grand Flat; La Sal and Abajo Mountains; Canyonlands/Natural Bridges

alerts.description: Between Frontage Road and County Road 232 (near Durango) from Mile Point 88 to Mile Point 89.5. Road construction. Full schedule below: • October 22, 7:00PM - October 23, 7:00AM Comment: The US 550-US 160 Grandview Interchange exit and entrance ramps will experience staggered nighttime closures from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Sunday night through Friday morning. Full schedule below: • October 19, 7:00PM - October 26, 7:00AM Comment: Expect alternating traffic and delays of up to 15 minutes 24/7 managed by a portable traffic signal. alerts.title: US 160 Pagosa Springs Reconstruction-147598
alerts.description: Between US 84 and Pike Drive (Pagosa Springs) from Mile Point 144.3 to Mile Point 141.8. Road construction. Starting October 22, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 22, 2026 at about 6:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 22, 7:00AM - October 22, 6:00PM Comment: Harman Park & Piedra Road-Work is underway at this intersection of US 160. Working hours will be intermittent day and night so motorists should plan for potential delays, Monday-Saturday. Please allow extra time to get through the work zone. Safety benefits of this work includes pedestrian safety upgrades and ADA accessibility improvements. Expect lane shifts and up to 15-minute delays. Crews will switch two-way traffic into the eastbound lanes, perform temporary striping operations and begin asphalt milling in the westbound lanes. Parking will not be permitted on US 160 and vehicles will be towed at the owner's expense. Westbound lane closures, 10’ width and 75’ length restrictions will remain in place 24/7 through end of 2026. Work is weather-dependent. For questions contact the project team at 970-335-9230 or Pagosa160reconstruction@gmail.com Project Webpage: www.codot.gov/projects/us160pagosasprings
